purpose: CPU implementation-sensitivity audit of the remaining provisional local4, not search for a predetermined level
queries: All26 returned reference matches for the sole remaining local4
Query self-alignment as a numerical positive control
coordinate_policy: Use unchanged saved query CA PDBs and convert2pdb from the same fingerprinted Foldseek database. No PDB-version substitution or coordinate relaxation.
method: Official standalone TMalign.cpp from pylelab/USalign, pinned commit and compiled locally; defaults including no fast flag. Query is Chain_1, use its normalized TM. Foldseek built-in scores remain preserved.
interpretation: Report every pair and maximum. Same categories with absolute best-score difference<=0.01 supports implementation repeatability for this finite set. A threshold crossing or larger difference is implementation-sensitive, not proof of organizer misclassification. Never alter thresholds or retire/reinstate a design based on this software check.
scope: Existing retired binder/control only; no generator, inference, exporter, account or submission work
